DESCRIPTION

[Amos] belongs to a fringe group of the Church of Desna, their task is to roam around, acting in a way like mercs but the goal is to work against evil governments, authorities, slave trades etc. In essence any kind of organization that oppresses people. The group is approximately 500ish operatives that are split, some act more to uphold good and some act more as out and out mercs, serving whichever side they can or get paid to serve. Amos belongs to the group with his childhood friend (the cleric I was going to make). They have been in the group since they were young, therefore well indoctrinated.
